# ezghcloud_mount_target (Resource)

A file system's NFS endpoint in one subnet, reachable from the whole VPC. Most file systems need one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ezghcloud_mount_target" "web" {
  project_id     = var.project_id
  file_system_id = ezghcloud_file_system.shared.id
  subnet_id      = var.subnet_id
}

# Mount with:
# sudo mount -t nfs4 -o nfsvers=4.1,xprtsec=tls,hard,noresvport,rsize=1048576,wsize=1048576,timeo=600,retrans=2 \
#   <hostname>:/<file system ID> /mnt/shared
output "mount_source" {
  value = "${ezghcloud_mount_target.web.hostname}:/${ezghcloud_file_system.shared.id}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file_system_id` (String) File system (fsy_) it serves. Changing it replaces the mount target.
- `project_id` (String) Project identifier. Changing it replaces the mount target.
- `subnet_id` (String) Subnet (sbn_) in the file system's VPC it gets its address in; one mount target per subnet per file system. Changing it replaces the mount target.

### Optional

- `allowed_source_cidrs` (Set of String) IPv4 CIDRs allowed to mount. Left out, the VPC's ranges. Changes in place.
- `name` (String) Name, 1 to 100 characters. Defaults to the mount target's ID.
- `tags` (Map of String) Resource tags.

### Read-Only

- `hostname` (String) DNS name to mount, as <hostname>:/<file system or access point ID>.
- `id` (String) Mount target ID (fmt_).
- `ip_address` (String) IPv4 address in the subnet.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization managed by the configured provider.
- `resource_name` (String) IAM resource name.
- `status` (String) What the mount target is doing: creating, available, deleting or failed.
- `vpc_id` (String) VPC of the subnet.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Replace identifiers with values from your organization.
terraform import ezghcloud_mount_target.example 'ORGANIZATION_ID/PROJECT_ID/RESOURCE_ID'
```
